source: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 NDVI (Planetary Computer), ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, CHIRPS v3 monthly, NASA POWER monthly T2M (MERRA-2), NOAA CPC RONI
license: Mixed, one per source. See the manifest of each source dataset. License wording of the MODIS collection on the Planetary Computer is not verified.
attribution: NASA LP DAAC MOD13Q1; ESA WorldCover project 2021 (CC BY 4.0); CHIRPS, Climate Hazards Center UC Santa Barbara; NASA POWER; NOAA CPC.
time_step: one row per cell and rainy season (May to October)
spatial_resolution: 0.05 degrees (about 5.5 km); NDVI read at about 1 km
label: ndvi_peak: maximum NDVI of the season, averaged over the cell with cropland fraction as weight. A proxy for crop condition. It is not yield.
limitations: NDVI overview at a quarter resolution: the pixel reliability band is not applied.
Clouds are handled only by the seasonal maximum.
The cropland map is from 2021 and is used for every year.
Temperature comes from a reanalysis grid of about 50 km, the nearest point.
Cells with less than 5 % cropland, or with any missing input, have no row.
note: Copy for the record. The checksums of the 311 MODIS composites were removed from this copy to keep it short.
